_help: 'nipples' = the base game's nipple mesh, shown on V with every body (the Hyst bodies leave it where the vanilla chest is, so it sticks out of Angel's upper breast by up to 2.6 mm); read from the game into every body's shape folder as part of the surface clothes must clear (fit 2.0). One entry per body; each works as source ('Outfit made for') and as target ('Your body mod'). Key = tool name of the body, also used in the output name (<Key>Refit_). 'xl' = the ArchiveXL {body} name (_<xl>.mesh), default = the key. 'archives' = file-name patterns of the body mod's .archive; it must replace the vanilla female body meshes listed in 'meshes'. 'game': true = the shape comes from the base game. 'hints' = words in an outfit's file name that mean 'made for this body' (a lower-case hint matches any case, one with capitals only exactly). 'shapes' = chest shape add-ons: ArchiveXL visual tag an outfit's .app can carry -> the body mod's mesh that then replaces submeshes 'shape_hide' of the full body (as the body's .xl does with hide: [0, 1, 2]). 'nipple_room' = extra mm of room over the breast tips (the body's nipple meshes stick out of its shape). 'uncovered' = the shape tag whose mesh is the body's chest with nothing worn over it (full body + the character creator's 'Big' chest morph; measured identical). The game shows it under clothes too (with chest size Big), so refits clear it as well as the normal shape. 'underbreast_room' = extra mm under the breasts (the soft lower breast swings out further in animations than a garment 4 mm over it follows; 1.9 engine only). 'cap_red' (fit 2.0): the body's GarmentSupport shape key swaps the chest shape instead of shrinking the body, so a garment worn next to the skin gets its garment-support cap painted red over the chest: the body then keeps its normal chest under it and the garment is fit to that shape alone.
